messages:
mara: Quick sketch — I pushed a proto for a lightweight scaling-policy engine that separates decision-making from execution. Goal: allow multiple objective plugins (latency / cost / fairness) and swap strategies without operator churn. feedback?
kevin: nice. can you high-level the dataflow? i.e. metrics -> policy -> action? how do we handle conflicting objectives?
yen: +1 on decoupling. for conflicts we should expose a prioritized objective vector, not a single scalar. e.g. {latency:0.6, cost:0.3, isolation:0.1}
sam: curious about burst behavior. we still need a fast-path that bypasses heavy scoring for sudden spikes (synthetic traffic, customer burst lanes)
mar a: exactly — proto includes a two-path approach: fast heuristics for <10s spikes, full policy scoring for steady-state. idea: fast-path emits temporary prewarm tokens, not permanent scale-up.
anika: safety note: whatever engine decides must be bounded by operator guardrails (max_gpus_per_pool, cooldowns, preempt_shield). otherwise we risk oscillation on noisy signals. :warning:
kevin: can we get a small DSL for policies? something like:

```
policy my-hybrid {
  objectives: latency:0.7, cost:0.3
  window: 30s
  score: pct(95, latency) * 0.7 + norm(cost) * 0.3
  fallback: fast-heuristic(prewarm=2)
}
```

kevin: operator reads decisions via REST exec endpoint. executor enforces quotas/guards.
yen: metrics inputs — prefer using aggregated token-rate, inflight, tail-latency histograms. avoid raw per-request traces in the hot path.
sam: what about tenant fairness? shared pools need per-tenant caps + soft-priority buckets. policy engine should emit per-tenant deltas.
man: ops-bot: reminder — new PR will trigger the autoscaler integration test suite. Please add a canary test for spike-to-fallback behavior.
mar a: plan: 1) land policy engine crate (pure decision logic, no cluster side-effects) 2) add REST decision API on operator 3) implement fast-path shim in executor 4) run perf + chaos tests
anika: ownership? mara + kevin on proto, sam for executor shim, yen for metrics interface, i'll add operator guardrails and e2e tests. also we should document failure modes.
kevin: perf question — scoring must be O(#tenants) at worst. no global optimization loops every second. suggest incremental scoring and windowed deltas.
yen: agree. use streaming aggregation and vectorized scoring. keep model simple so rollbacks are easy. :thumbsup:
mar a: open questions: how to version policies (policy id + schema), CB safety when policy crashes, and migration for existing heuristic configs. we should support a compatibility layer that reads old config -> generated policy.
sam: logging — decisions must include rationale: inputs used, score breakdown, and guardrail hits. helpful for postmortems.
anika: also add a "dry-run" mode that emits decisions to telemetry but doesn't execute.
mar a: thanks all. i'll update the PR with a minimal DSL example, add the dry-run toggle, and a short runbook for operator actions on flapping pools. meeting to align on Friday?
kevin: friday works. :+1:
yen: ack. :rocket:
ops-bot: deploybot: integration-tests queued for branch/mara/policy-proto — will post results to #eng-runtime when done.
